name: bird-queries-validation
description: A validation set of query-image pairs for bird-related retrieval tasks. It measures a model's ability to match textual queries about birds to the correct images (and vice versa), evaluating fine-grained visual recognition and cross-modal retrieval. Typically used to assess retrieval/grounding models on ornithological image collections.
reputation: A small, domain-specific validation split used by researchers working on fine-grained image-text retrieval; modest community recognition.
